answer_1.quote: Controllable Dialogue Generation (CDG) has been proposed to enhance the realism and accuracy of responses generated by conversational models...

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation To assess controllability, we train two RoBERTa-based evaluators on the DailyDialog training set: one for emotion and one for dialog-act... For quality, ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L are measured... Dist-1 and Dist-2 are computed to evaluate diversity... For grammar, the probability of grammaticality is utilized by the RoBERTa-based CoLA grammaticality model.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation Experiments on the Director model... We asked three expert evaluators to rate each metric on a scale of 1 to 5... (1) Accuracy: Response is generated according to the desired attribute. (2) Interest: Response is specific and creative enough to capture the user's attention... (3) Sensible: Response is grammatically correct and contextually coherent.
answer_4.guideline: Three expert evaluators rated metrics on a 1-5 scale for Accuracy, Interest, and Sensibility
